narration: Observe... carefully! Why does a ball thrown sideways fall at the exact same time as one dropped straight down?
Your intuition screams that forward speed delays the fall... but nature plays a different game! Gravity pulls downward, yet it cares nothing for your forward motion.
Horizontal velocity remains perfectly constant because acceleration in the x-direction is zero! Meanwhile, vertical velocity increases by nine point eight meters per second squared.
And behold! Two entirely independent motions blend into a single flawless parabola! Test your newfound mastery in the quiz below...
